name: Game Boy Color
description: Nintendo's colour Game Boy, released in 1998. It kept the original's resolution but added a colour screen, a double-speed CPU mode, more memory and an infrared port, while still playing older Game Boy games. It carried Pokémon Gold and Silver and filled the gap until the Game Boy Advance.

specs.graphics: 160 × 144 colour LCD, up to 56 colours from 32,768
specs.unitsSold: About 118.69 million (Game Boy and Game Boy Color combined)

curiosities: It automatically colourises original Game Boy games, and holding button combinations at boot picks a different palette.
Black cartridges work on both the Game Boy and Game Boy Color; clear cartridges run only on the Color.
Its built-in infrared port let some games exchange data between consoles without a cable.
Like the original Game Boy, its screen had no backlight.
story: Nine years after the Game Boy, Nintendo gave it colour: the Game Boy Color launched in October 1998, twice as fast, with up to 56 colours on screen and still playing every Game Boy game.
Pokémon was at its peak, and Gold and Silver, Link's Awakening DX, the Oracle games and Super Mario Bros. Deluxe sold it. Its infrared port let games swap data without a cable.
Counted with the Game Boy, it sold about 119 million units, and it bridged the way to the Game Boy Advance.
